gpu_lines.common: Each line: one FORGE_GPU_DRY_RUN=1 dry run first (expected exit 78), then forge-gpu-run --min 30 --max <=1800 --label p1f1-<line> -- timeout <=1750s python3 -B scripts/apa_p1f1_gpu.py <mode> --out artifacts/apa_p1f1/gpu/<line>, from the worktree root. Before the lease the script refuses a module whose sha256 differs from its build receipt, and for Build F/FH a working tree whose engine source sha map differs from the receipt; Build B is checked against 8728e67e... Exit 76 = nothing ran (retry unchanged after >= 5 min, <= 6 times). Exit 124 = timeout, never a pass. Bitwise = np.array_equal on same-width unsigned views after dtype and shape checks; every bitwise pair checks both sides nonzero and non-constant. 'Nothing launched' is shown by an LD_PRELOAD counter of cudaLaunchKernel (libcudart.so.12 is dynamically linked; positive control: the accepted call counts > 0).
